articles.headline: Steve Kerr, Chris Finch want NBA to alter how it calls flopping techs
articles.description: Both Chris Finch and Steve Kerr expressed a desire for the league to alter the way they are calling flopping violations, saying they should focus more on offense.

articles.headline: Timberwolves say Anthony Edwards will be 'good as new' after knee surgery
articles.description: The Timberwolves believe Anthony Edwards will be "good as new" following arthroscopic surgery for a lingering injury to his right knee.
